name: idea-alchemist
belief: Claims it emits have a falsifier the orchestrator can run in under one hour.
kill_line: In the first 3 uses, 2 or more claims have no falsifier runnable in under one hour.

name: idea-curator
belief: Its single reframe changes which option the orchestrator picks, or surfaces an option nobody had listed.
kill_line: In 2 of the first 3 uses the reframe changes no pick and adds no new option.

name: idea-librarian
belief: Every cite resolves mechanically (path exists, line in range).
kill_line: Any cite fails a path-and-line resolution check, or adr058_read is false.

name: idea-detective
belief: The weak joint it names is where the thing actually breaks when tested.
kill_line: In 2 of the first 3 uses the real failure was somewhere other than the named joint.

name: scenario-runner
belief: At least one pre-mortem falsifier per run gets executed and informs a decision.
kill_line: In 2 of the first 3 uses no falsifier is executed or any graph edge has no stated basis for its p.

name: chief-loki
belief: It finds at least one real defect the orchestrator had not found.
kill_line: Across 3 uses it finds zero defects the orchestrator had not already found.

name: chief-bayesian
kill_line: Across 3 uses that contain a planted unsupported prior, it misses it in 2 or more.

name: chief-conductor
belief: The orchestrator or user does not reverse its ranking.
kill_line: In 2 of the first 3 uses the user or orchestrator reverses the top pick.
